# IPRegistry

IPRegistry provides IP geolocation, network, company, carrier, threat, autonomous-system, and user-agent intelligence.

Category: Data. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/ip-registry/.

## Actions

- **Batch Look Up ASNs** (read-only): Return ordered Autonomous System lookup results for 1 to 16 ASNs.
- **Batch Look Up IP Addresses** (read-only): Return ordered lookup results for 1 to 1024 public IP addresses.
- **Look Up ASN** (read-only): Return organization, country, registry, network-prefix, and relationship data for one public Autonomous System Number.
- **Look Up IP Address** (read-only): Return geolocation, network, company, carrier, time-zone, currency, and threat data for one public IPv4 or IPv6 address.
- **Parse User Agents** (read-only): Parse 1 to 256 raw User-Agent strings into browser or application, device, rendering-engine, and operating-system details in input order.
